messages.content: Identify the type of blood cells responsible for clotting.

function.name: cellBiology_getCellType
function.description: This function will return the type of the cell based on it's characteristics. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

nucleus_count.description: The number of nucleus in the cell.

organism_type.description: The type of organism the cell belongs to.

membrane_type.description: Type of membrane in the cell, default value is 'Phospholipid bi-layer'

message.content: Blood cells primarily responsible for clotting are **platelets** (also called thrombocytes). Platelets aggregate at sites of vascular injury and release factors that trigger the coagulation cascade, forming a platelet plug that stabilizes the developing fibrin meshwork into a stable blood clot.
message.reasoning:
The user asks: Identify the type of blood cells responsible for clotting.

We need to answer with the name of the blood cells involved in clotting. That would be platelets (thrombocytes). They are not true cells but fragments from megakaryocytes; they play key role in hemostasis/clot formation. So we should respond accordingly. No tool needed.
